description: Subjects shared by the seeded curricula. Subjects are not tied to a curriculum: a topic joins a subject to a level.

subjects.name: Mathematics
subjects.description: Number, algebra, geometry, statistics and probability.

subjects.name: Science
subjects.description: Integrated science: physics, chemistry and biology taught as one subject (as in CBSE).

subjects.name: Social Science
subjects.description: History, geography, political science and economics taught as one subject (as in CBSE).

subjects.name: Biology
subjects.description: Living things: cells, organisms, ecosystems, inheritance and health.

subjects.name: Chemistry
subjects.description: Substances, their structure and properties, and how they react.

subjects.name: Physics
subjects.description: Energy, forces, electricity, waves, matter and space.

subjects.name: Geography
subjects.description: Physical landscapes, natural hazards, people and the environment.
